name: Elemental Ammunition (Greater, Fire)
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
When activated, the reservoir of alchemical reagents in elemental ammunition atomizes on impact, dealing 3d4 persistent fire damage to the target and 3 splash fire damage in addition to the damage the attack normally deals. Each damage type requires a different formula, and the ammunition gains a trait matching the damage type.
